title: Delhi HC Orders Paytm Payments Bank Winding Up After RBI Licence Cancellation
description: RBI states Delhi HC ordered winding up of Paytm Payments Bank, appointed an Official Liquidator and vested Board powers in the liquidator from 08.07.2026.The post Delhi HC Orders Paytm Payments Bank Winding Up After RBI Licence Cancellation appeared first on TaxGuru.
